cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Let me submit the form tomorrow. Today can be a trial extension.

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: A flatters its former forms pupil careful checking into granting a first extension, then immediately treats that bounded trial as a basis for future requests.
confusable: Not simply requesting more time: A explicitly preserves the one-day decision as tested precedent after it is granted.
comparison: Shift-handover precedent versus trial extension in an untested process.
